Research
:::

# Public law as infrastructure for innovation

::: {.lede}
My doctoral research at UCL's Institute for Innovation and Public Purpose
examining the legal conditions under which public institutions can invest,
experiment, and share in the rewards of innovation, and the constitutional
and administrative constraints that bear on them.
:::

My previous research explored different issues related to the provision of
public services, administrative sanctions and environmental law.

## Research interests

- Administrative law and regulatory design
- Comparative constitutional law
- Public purpose innovation and mission-oriented policy
- Socio-legal methods and policy analysis
- State capacity and the law of public administration

## Working papers

::: {.entries}
- ::: {.meta}
  Working paper · 2026
  :::
  **Regulatory Accumulation and Simplification Reform in Chile.** The study
  analyses two recent simplification reforms in Chile (L. 21.770 and L.
  21.718) in order to identify the links between discourses on regulatory
  accumulation and legal responses.

  [Law 21.770](https://www.bcn.cl/leychile/navegar?idNorma=1216930) ·
  [Law 21.718](https://www.bcn.cl/leychile/navegar?idNorma=1208743)
:::
